description: Before buying or accepting a token: simulates a buy and sell on the deepest pool (Uniswap V2/V3/V4 + Aerodrome on Base, Uniswap V2/V3/V4 on Ethereum, Uniswap V2/V3 on Arbitrum, Uniswap V2/V3 + Velodrome on Optimism) to detect honeypots and taxes, and checks owner powers (mint/pause/blacklist/fees), upgradeable proxy, liquidity, copycat symbols and sanctioned owner. Solana mints: freeze/mint authority, permanent delegate, transfer fees and hooks (Token-2022), holder concentration, Jupiter quote round trip and an on-chain sell simulation for a real holder. Verdict avoid/caution/ok with a signed receipt. $0.01 per call after the free daily quota.

address.description: Token contract address (0x...) or Solana mint (base58)

chain.description: Default base (solana is inferred from a base58 address). Buy/sell simulation on base, ethereum, arbitrum and optimism; solana gets mint/freeze authority and Token-2022 extension checks.
